name: ivantha
description: Source for ivantha.com — personal site + Typst CV SSOT
author: Oshan Mudannayake

scripts.build:cv: mkdir -p public/cv && typst compile --root . --font-path cv/fonts cv/variants/academic/main.typ public/cv/academic-cv.pdf && typst compile --root . --font-path cv/fonts cv/variants/casual/main.typ public/cv/casual-cv.pdf && typst compile --root . --font-path cv/fonts cv/variants/ats/main.typ public/cv/ats-cv.pdf && node scripts/build-ats-txt.mjs
scripts.build:cv:academic: mkdir -p public/cv && typst compile --root . --font-path cv/fonts cv/variants/academic/main.typ public/cv/academic-cv.pdf
scripts.build:cv:casual: mkdir -p public/cv && typst compile --root . --font-path cv/fonts cv/variants/casual/main.typ public/cv/casual-cv.pdf
scripts.build:cv:ats: mkdir -p public/cv && typst compile --root . --font-path cv/fonts cv/variants/ats/main.typ public/cv/ats-cv.pdf && node scripts/build-ats-txt.mjs
